findings.finding: Q1 FY5/27 domestic BOOKOFF direct existing-store sales were 104.5% (Jun), 110.2% (Jul), 107.8% (Aug), roughly 107.5% for the quarter and all-store ~108.6%, against last year's Q1 of 100.1/102.6/109.3% whose soft June-July plus normalised costs cut Q1 OP to 482m (-56.6%) and domestic segment profit to 1,123m (-21.6%); with the cost step-up now lapped, few Q1 openings, and FY26's flow-through of +8% domestic sales into +19% segment profit, Q1 OP plausibly lands ~900-1,200m (ordinary ~1,000-1,300m) against the IFIS Q1 ordinary bar of 600m, i.e. a ~2x YoY headline.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Actual release dates from kabutan, close-to-next-close: Q1 FY5/25 (2024-10-22, OP 1,112m, +172% YoY) +11.87%; Q1 FY5/26 (2025-10-14, OP -57%) -0.97%; Q2 FY5/26 (2026-01-13, Q2 OP roughly doubled) +9.31%; Q3 FY5/26 with upward revision (2026-04-13) +13.18%; FY5/26 with FY27 guide above consensus (2026-07-13) +5.65%. Profit beats have been bought hard; a weak Q1 was barely sold.
findings.why_not_priced: The sales are public but the profit is not: last year sales +4.3% came with OP -57%, so the 月次 do not pin the quarter's profit, and the only sell-side number visible (IFIS Q1 ordinary 600m on kabuyoho) sits at last year's depressed level, i.e. it has not been marked up for the stronger Q1 comp. If the market had priced a ~2x Q1, the stock would not have given back the whole late-September run (3,050 -> 2,730) on an index-flow headline and would not carry a 信用倍率 of 0.44 with margin shorts outnumbering longs.

findings.finding: On 2026-10-09 the company disclosed unauthorised access to a subsidiary's member-management system with up to ~6.43m member-number records (names, addresses, birthdates, hashed passwords; no payment data) potentially leaked, detected 2026-10-06; the Q1 release may carry a 後発事象 note or an impact comment, and any response cost (notification, possible apology points, security spend) falls after the Q1 period.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior incident; the disclosure itself moved the stock -0.07% close-to-close on 2026-10-09 (2,733 -> 2,731) on the same day several other large Japanese leaks were reported.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the market looked through the disclosure. What is not priced is a quantified cost or compensation scheme if the release adds one; absent that the item is ~0, and any cost is a Q2 one-off below OP with no path to the FY guide.

findings.finding: JPX named 9278 a 移行措置銘柄 under the new TOPIX rules on 2026-10-07 (weight cut in eight quarterly steps, removal end-July 2028 unless it requalifies in the October 2027 review), and the stock fell 5.1% on 2026-10-08 on passive-supply fear; no reduction step falls inside the window, so the drop is a non-fundamental reset of the base the print is measured from.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: One observation: -5.1% on 2026-10-08 (2,880 -> 2,733), +- 0 the next day.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced as a supply overhang; it cuts both ways inside the window (a lower base for a good print versus continuing passive pre-selling), so it is filed at 0.

outside_window.finding: TOPIX transition-measure weight reductions begin at the next quarterly step (eight steps to end-July 2028); passive selling of each step falls after the 2026-10-14 exit.
Any special loss / compensation cost for the 6.43m-record leak would be booked in Q2 (Sep-Nov 2026) and reported in January 2027 unless quantified earlier.
